07
/ 07 Plant genetics

Breed the perfect
clone, every time.

Real crossbreeding math, not a slider — green genes (Growth/Yield/Hardiness) weigh 0.6, red genes (Water/Empty) weigh 1.0 and only flip a slot when a donor's combined weight strictly beats the center's own. Click any gene below, or run a simulated cross.

  • Genome visualization for any clone
  • Real weight-based crossbreed simulation
  • Target genetics with live match %
  • Two donor slots, same as an in-game planter
Open Genetics Lab
Genome Comparison
0% to target
Hemp · Large Planter Box
Target genome — most crops: GGGYYY (3 Growth, 3 Yield)
Donor A
Center · your clone
Donor B

Plant your two best clones either side of the one you want to improve — only neighbours cross.

Target
G Growth Y Yield H Hardiness W Water (avoid) X Empty (avoid)
Donor weight must strictly exceed the center's own — a tie keeps the center's gene, same as in-game.

Click any Center, Donor A, or Donor B gene to cycle it — the match score updates live.

your dashboard.

The dashboard unlocks as soon as a plan is active. Every tier is a single flat price — no per-seat billing, no per-server surcharge.

Save 20%on yearly billing

Scout

For a solo player holding one base.

$4.99 / month
  • 2 paired servers
  • Team tracker & map
  • Raid alarms to web push
  • Decay timers
  • 7-day event history
  • Phone call escalation
  • Vending & shop alerts
Most popular

Raider

For a squad running a wipe properly.

$9.99 / month
  • Up to 5 paired servers
  • Everything in Scout
  • Phone call escalation
  • Vending search & shop alerts

Clan

For a full clan with several bases.

$19.99 / month
  • Unlimited paired servers
  • Everything in Raider

Prices in USD. Cancel any time — access runs to the end of the period you already paid for.

Checkout isn't connected yet

You need a Steam account to subscribe
Rustex pairs through Rust's own in-game request, so billing is tied to the Steam account you actually play on. Signing in takes one click and we never see your Steam password.

Rust+ pairing

Pair straight from the game.

Rustex receives the same in-game request the official Rust+ app uses. Nothing to copy, nothing to type.

1
Sign in with Steam
Links Rustex to the account you play on.
Done
2
In Rust, press ESC → Rust+
Load into the server you want to track first.
3
Hit Pair With Server
It appears below within a second or two.
Waiting
Paired servers
Nothing paired yet
Complete the three steps above and your server lands here.
Enter connection details manually

Manual entry still needs the player ID and token the game issues, so pairing from the pause menu is almost always faster.
